## What I Build

I've been in AI long enough to know the work is mostly gaps.

The useful work is noticing those gaps, understanding why they matter, and building the small tools that close them.

Everything here started as something I needed for my own work. If it removes friction for me, it usually ends up being useful to other people too.

## Featured Projects

![Total Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/vanzan01?style=social&label=Total%20Stars)
![Profile Views](https://komarev.com/ghpvc/?username=vanzan01&style=social)

### 🚀 Agent SDK & Pipelines *(Current Focus)*
- **[claude-agent-sdk-starter](https://github.com/vanzan01/claude-agent-sdk-starter)** — Pipeline-first framework for building AI applications. Pipelines are the product, UIs are just clients. [Read the blog post](https://blog.vanzan01.org/posts/2026/harnessing-wild-ai/)
- **[pi-agent-sdk-starter](https://github.com/vanzan01/pi-agent-sdk-starter)** — Batteries-included starter for building agentic desktop apps on the Pi SDK. Electron + React shell, Pi runtime, configurable providers. Demo ships a verified researcher → analyst → writer pipeline.

### 🧠 Context Engineering & Memory Systems
- **[cursor-memory-bank](https://github.com/vanzan01/cursor-memory-bank)** — Persistent AI memory with visual process maps. VAN/PLAN/CREATIVE lifecycle for structured AI development
- **[Claude-Code-MindPalace](https://github.com/vanzan01/Claude-Code-MindPalace)** — Never write commit messages again. Auto-checkpoint, auto-squash into professional git history

### 🤖 Multi-Agent Orchestration
- **[claude-code-sub-agent-collective](https://github.com/vanzan01/claude-code-sub-agent-collective)** — Hub-and-spoke coordination through Claude Code. Context engineering research in action. One of the very first long running agents.

### 🔌 MCP Servers & Integrations
- **[cline.code](https://github.com/vanzan01/cline.code)** — OpenAI-compatible API bridge for Claude.Code via MCP
- **[atomic-writer-mcp](https://github.com/vanzan01/atomic-writer-mcp)** — Atomic file operations. Built to test MCP. Launch month after watching AI overwrite my Obsidian notes one too many times
- **[poe2scout-mcp](https://github.com/vanzan01/poe2scout-mcp)** — POE2 trading intelligence: 11 specialized tools for currency analysis & arbitrage

### 🧰 Developer Tools
- **[markdown-viewer](https://github.com/vanzan01/markdown-viewer)** — Professional markdown viewer for Windows/macOS. Perfect for sharing AI outputs with non-technical staff
- **[claude-code-reclaimr](https://github.com/vanzan01/claude-code-reclaimr)** — Intelligent file organization assistant. 7/30-day archiving while you sleep
- **[yt-whisper-analyzer](https://github.com/vanzan01/yt-whisper-analyzer)** — YouTube transcription & keyword analysis via Whisper/Groq
- **[whisper-remote](https://github.com/vanzan01/whisper-remote)** — Trigger Whisper Flow from your phone. Walk around, dictate, hit enter — stay in flow

### 🎮 Side Projects
- **[elden-ring-interactive-guide](https://github.com/vanzan01/elden-ring-interactive-guide)** — Interactive quest tracker for Elden Ring
